home.lead: Register as a farmer, record your farm and money activity, and get AI-assisted loan, insurance and market decisions.
home.feature_credit_body: Your loan risk is scored from farm, financial, market and weather records instead of a guarantor.
home.feature_weather_body: Rainfall and temperature risk for your region, with an SMS warning before it hits.
home.feature_market_body: See current prices for your crop and decide when to sell.
home.feature_insurance_body: Cover for drought and flood damage, with claims tracked in one place.
home.feature_assistant_body: Ask a question in English or Kiswahili and get an answer grounded in your own records.
home.feature_ussd_body: No smartphone or data bundle needed. Check your balance and loan status from any phone.
home.step1_body: Register with your phone number and a password.
home.step2_title: Add your farm and money records
home.step2_body: Record crops, harvests, income and expenses as you go.
home.step3_body: Apply for a loan or insurance and see a clear, explained result.
home.channels_body: Use the web portal, USSD or SMS. The interface is built for low bandwidth.

assistant.irrigate_rain_coming: You can wait: about {rain} mm of rain is predicted in the next {days} days. Water only if the topsoil dries out before then.
assistant.irrigate_ok: Your crop is not short of water right now. Irrigate only when the topsoil is dry.
assistant.irrigate_facts: Rain in the last 30 days: {rain} mm. Your {crop} crop needs about {need} mm over the season. Forecast for the next {days} days: {forecast} mm.
assistant.irrigate_tips:
How to irrigate well:
• Water early in the morning or late in the afternoon, when less is lost to the sun.
• Water at the base of the plants, not on the leaves.
• Cover the soil with mulch (dry grass or crop leftovers) to hold the moisture.
• Push a finger 5 cm into the soil - if it is dry, water again.
assistant.irrigate_next: Next step: check the soil today and water the driest part of the farm first.
assistant.plant_good: Good timing: about {rain} mm of rain is predicted in the next {days} days, a good window to plant {crop}.
assistant.plant_wait: Only {rain} mm of rain is predicted in the next {days} days. Plant {crop} now only if you can irrigate; otherwise wait until the rains have soaked the soil.
assistant.plant_tips:
Planting tips:
• Use certified seed from a registered agro-dealer.
• Plant when the soil is moist to about 15 cm deep.
• Keep the spacing on the seed packet so plants do not compete for water.
assistant.fert_ok: Conditions are fine for fertiliser: apply it when the soil is moist.
assistant.fert_heavy_rain: Do not apply fertiliser just before {date}: about {rain} mm of rain is predicted that day and could wash it away. Apply it after the heavy rain.
assistant.fert_dry: The soil is very dry now. Fertiliser works best after rain or irrigation, so water first.
assistant.fert_tips:
Fertiliser tips:
• Apply basal fertiliser (for example DAP) at planting, and top-dress (for example Urea or CAN) 3-6 weeks later.
• Place it a hand's width from the stem, never on the leaves.
• A soil test from your extension officer tells you exactly how much you need.
assistant.pests_intro: I cannot see your {crop}, but here is how to protect it:
assistant.pests_humid: Humidity is high ({humidity}%), which helps fungal diseases spread. Check the leaves for spots this week.
assistant.pests_tips:
• Walk through the farm twice a week and look under the leaves.
• Remove and destroy badly damaged plants early.
• Use only registered pesticides, at the dose on the label, with protective clothing.
• If you cannot name the pest, take a photo to your extension officer.
assistant.store_tips:
How to store your harvest safely:
• Dry it well first - grain should snap, not bend.
• Use clean, airtight (hermetic) bags.
• Keep bags on pallets, off the floor and away from walls.
• Check every two weeks for insects and mould.
assistant.store_price_up: {crop} prices are predicted to rise, so good storage could earn you more later.
assistant.not_understood:
I'm not sure what you're asking. I can help with:
• Selling - "Is now a good time to sell my maize?"
• Watering - "Should I irrigate this week?"
• Planting, fertiliser, pests and storage
• Weather, prices, loans and insurance
